summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K to report an unregistered sale of common shares and routine portfolio disclosures. The fund issued approximately 3.25 million common shares at $24.80 per share for an aggregate of about $80.6 million, relying on Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D exemptions. Item 7.01 provided portfolio metrics as of July 31, 2026, including 62 portfolio companies, ~$1.98 billion in loan commitments, and a 9.4% weighted average yield. This is a standard capital raise for a BDC/closed-end fund, not a special situation. No tender, acquisition, restructuring, or strategic transaction was announced.
